\## Summary

This branch follows the corrected scope: PYTHIA / original TOE-HR lineage / "the code beneath the code". It does not extend the P-vs-NP or Yang-Mills workstreams.

## Changes

- Adds \`python\_backend/core\_modules/lucas\_formal\_api.py\` with exact integer matrix powers and a JSON-safe audit API.
- Certifies the algebraic identity \`tr(M\^n) = L\_n\` for \`M = \[\[1,1\],\[1,0\]\]\` through an explicit base-case and recurrence schema.
- Checks exact unimodular and Lucas-Cassini invariants.
- Builds a progressive ladder for every power \`1..N\`; no single Lucas power is treated as representative.
- Adds an explicit Decimal Pisot residual audit with rounding tolerance rather than confusing floating evaluation with the exact proof.
- Exposes the certificate through the Python bridge as \`formal\_lucas\_audit\` and HTTP \`POST /api/v1/sovereign/formal/lucas\`.
- Exports the formal API from \`core\_modules\` and documents the source archaeology and claim boundaries.

## Verification

- \`tests/test\_lucas\_formal\_api.py\`: 4 tests passed locally.
- Tests cover exact trace values, the induction recurrence, Cassini/unimodular invariants, progressive scaling, JSON serialization, and explicit non-claims.

## Evidence boundary

The formal target is the stated algebraic identity and its exact invariants. This PR does not claim that the missing original \`toe.py\` source has been recovered, nor that an HR predictor, hardware speedup, or broader physical/computational theorem has been proven.
